content.short: Tulip is the first yield aggregation platform built on Solana.
content.description: Tulip is a DeFi yield farming platform built on the Solana blockchain, offering three primary yield products: Vault, Lending, and Leveraged farming. Vault strategies are designed to compound over time, benefiting from Solana’s fast execution and low transaction costs to support steady growth. By prioritizing security and efficiency, Tulip aims to help farmers achieve higher yield APY and lower gas fees through its robust farming tools and reliable services.
